Profession: Graphic Designer / Brand Strategist | Style: Bold Afrocentric Type-Led
[HERO: Animated Colour-Block Grid — No Image, No Video]

Build a complete, fully responsive portfolio website for a Nigerian brand identity
and graphic designer based in Abuja who works with African businesses, cultural
organisations, and creative entrepreneurs. Primary goal: attract brand strategy
clients and agency partnerships. DISTINCTION: the hero is a pure CSS animated
typographic experience — no photography, no video — just bold type and moving
colour blocks. The design itself is the proof of skill.
Design aesthetic: Afrocentric maximalism, restrained — warm black (#0D0B0B) base,
vivid saffron yellow (#F5A623) as primary accent, terracotta (#C0522A) as warmth
accent, cream (#FDF5E6) for light sections. Font: Syne ExtraBold (800) for all
headings — sharp, editorial, distinctly design-forward. Syne Regular (17px) for
body. Full-bleed typography, asymmetric grid layouts, colour-block section
dividers. This portfolio should make a brand director stop scrolling and send
an email within 60 seconds.
